description: Repository-local standard-library envelope. Planned modules reserve ownership boundaries only; active modules name existing source and test evidence.

modules.name: std.core
modules.contract: Core scalar and absence-adjacent helpers once they have named API contracts.

modules.name: std.collections
modules.contract: List, dict, matrix, and iterator helpers that do not require compiler-intrinsic ownership.

modules.name: std.io
modules.contract: IO helpers above language-core resource identifiers and runtime primitives.

modules.name: std.math
modules.contract: General numeric helpers after scalar/container typing and diagnostics are stable.

modules.name: std.path
modules.contract: Path manipulation helpers that remain separate from raw resource topology syntax.

modules.name: std.process
modules.contract: Process helpers after CLI/native trust boundaries and resource effects are specified.

modules.name: std.resource
modules.contract: Compatibility manifest entry for the current standard resource prelude declarations.
modules.trim_policy: May move out of src and become package-managed after compiler import/package handoff exists.

modules.name: std.stream
modules.contract: Stream helpers after IM-D5 route, zip, backpressure, and task semantics are stable.

modules.name: std.test
modules.contract: Test helper API after source-level test runner behavior is specified.

modules.name: std.text
modules.contract: Text/string helpers above compiler-owned string literals and format strings.

modules.name: std.time
modules.contract: Time and duration helpers after runtime clock/error contracts are specified.
